mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_effect_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE order_effect_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,attempts=attempts+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status<>'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE order_effect_outbox SET status='RETRY',attempts=attempts+1, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '5' SECOND WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_effect_inbox(consumer_group,event_id,topic) VALUES(#{group},#{eventId},#{topic}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
